data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an overall gross claims reserve strengthening of GBP 5.614 million for prior underwriting years (2019 and older), representing 3.40% of opening gross reserves. This includes a specific cumulative GAAP loss of GBP 4.640 million in respect of 2018 and prior years, primarily due to a strengthening of the Casualty UK account following an in-depth actuarial assessment of reserves.
